claims.label: Text Message From Candace Owens to Andrew Kolvet Described Charlie Kirk Dream Stating He Was Betrayed and Andrew Knew More Than Publicly Stated
claims.claim: The host presented a text message she sent to Andrew Kolvet describing a vivid dream in which Charlie Kirk stated he was betrayed, that "they" were hiding what happened "to my left," and that Kolvet "know[s] much more than you've said publicly or privately."
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain verification of the text exchange; identify the date and any reply correspondence; corroborate with any other recipients who received analogous communications.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet Never Replied to the Dream Text From Candace Owens
claims.claim: The host stated that Andrew Kolvet did not respond to her text message and that this was the last time they spoke.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify non-reply independently; cross-check any subsequent communication records between the two parties.

claims.label: Christianity Today reported Johnnie Moore arrived at Liberty University dorms at age 14
claims.claim: The host reads from Christianity Today that "Johnnie Moore was only 14 when he first stayed in the dorms at Liberty University" and that he had remained at the school founded by Jerry Falwell Senior.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the original Christianity Today article; identify author, publication date, and full article context.

claims.label: Johnnie Moore and his single mother family briefly lived in Liberty University dorms following parental divorce and temporary homelessness
claims.claim: Christianity Today reported that Moore and his single-mother family briefly lived in Liberty University dorms after his parents' divorce and a temporary stretch of homelessness.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve original Christianity Today article and corroborate against any independent biographical sources.

claims.label: New York Times reported 180 LDP lawmakers had ties to the Unification Church
claims.claim: The New York Times reported that an internal audit by Japan's Liberal Democratic Party found approximately 180 elected lawmakers (almost half of the party's parliamentary membership) had accepted donations from or attended events of the Unification Church and related organizations.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the cited New York Times article; verify exact figures and any subsequent party responses.

claims.label: Johnnie Moore stated he is involved with ADL and Aspen Institute civil society fellowship
claims.claim: In audio played on the episode, Johnnie Moore stated he is "a part of the ADL and Aspen Institute civil society… in fellowship."
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Moore's listed fellowships directly through ADL and Aspen Institute public records.

claims.label: Johnnie Moore stated he serves on the ADL and Aspen Institute advisory board
claims.claim: Johnnie Moore stated in the audio clip that he is on the advisory board for the Aspen Institute and ADL civil society fellowship.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify advisory board membership through both organizations' published directories.

claims.label: Johnnie Moore stated commitment to building a "great wall of Christian Zionism"
claims.claim: Johnnie Moore stated in audio that he is committed to "building a great wall of Christian Zionism all over the world to push back the forces of anti-semitism."
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original venue and date of this speech; verify exact wording through primary source.

claims.label: Sun Myung Moon declared Ron Godwin as one of three disciples
claims.claim: The host presented a Sun Myung Moon quotation declaring Ron Godwin to be one of three disciples, charged with multiplying their own disciples.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve the primary source (Unification Church publication, sermon, or recorded address) containing this declaration; verify date and venue.

claims.label: Sun Myung Moon's quoted instruction: each disciple must multiply three disciples of their own
claims.claim: The host presented a Sun Myung Moon quotation stating: "Each one of you will put yourself in Jesus's position and multiply three disciples of your own."
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve primary source; verify whether this directive was organizational doctrine or rhetorical.

claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Knesset speaker; obtain Knesset record of the speech; verify date and verbatim transcript.

claims.label: Megyn Kelly stated she was called a coward by Ben Shapiro at Turning Point Amfest event

claims.investigative_direction: Obtain video of Amfest remarks; verify date, exact wording, and surrounding context.

claims.label: Host Says the Falkirk Center Scandal Could Have Felled Both Falwell Jr. and Kirk
claims.claim: The host says she now believes the scandal around the Falkirk Center could have led to the fall of both Jerry Falwell Jr. and Charlie Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Falkirk Center founding and wind-down records, Liberty University board minutes and dated reporting on Falwell Jr.'s exit to test whether the center's end is linked to Kirk's later fortunes.
claims.transcript_snippet: Obviously scandal scandal which I now believe could have led to the fall of both men.

claims.label: Host Lists the Post-Assassination PR Operations She Says Were Run Against Her
claims.claim: The host lists a sequence of what she calls PR operations since the assassination: 'he wasn't Catholic', 'Candace hasn't spoken to Charlie in years', 'LOL Egyptian planes' and 'Debunk Mitch in Fort Huachuca with Baby Mama Drama', and says whoever runs them is panicking.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the dated public statements and posts behind each named narrative with the host's timeline of when each appeared and who first amplified it.
claims.transcript_snippet: There was a operation he wasn't Catholic. Furious, followed by Operation Candace hasn't spoken to Charlie in years, followed by Operation Lol Egyptian Plains, followed by Operation Debunk Mitch in Fort Huachuca with Baby Mama Drama.

claims.label: Host Imagines a Wealthy Backer Phoning People With Bitcoin Offers to Call Her Crazy
claims.claim: The host suggests someone with a lot of money is phoning people offering $600,000 in Bitcoin to say Candace has gone crazy; she presents this as her illustration of how the operations feel, not as a named incident.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host whether any named person was actually offered money to disparage her; otherwise treat as illustrative. Check paid-clipping campaign records already in the monument.
claims.transcript_snippet: Like he's just phoning people up like I'll give you $600,000 and have that money transferred in your account with Bitcoin today.

claims.label: Host Says She Believes the Operation Mocking Her Dreams Is Run by a Person Personally Victimized by Them
claims.claim: The host says the 'Operation LOL, Candace has dreams' campaign persists in pockets of the internet and that she believes whoever directs it feels personally victimized by her dream.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the accounts that first pushed the dream-mocking narrative and any link to TPUSA staff or contractors.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think it's someone who feels personally victimized by the dream

claims.label: Host Says Her Husband Told Her to See a Priest and They Spoke About Souls in Purgatory
claims.claim: The host says that, overwhelmed by nightly vivid dreams after the assassination, she told her husband through tears and he advised her to consult a priest, which she did, and they spoke about souls in purgatory.
claims.investigative_direction: Only the host can supply the priest's identity and date; any corroboration would come from her husband or the priest.
claims.transcript_snippet: he told me that I should consult a priest which I did and we spoke about souls in purgatory.

claims.label: Host Says the Repeat Dream Replayed a Real 2018 Lunch With Charlie in Israel
claims.claim: The host says her repeating post-assassination dream was a replay of a real lunch with Charlie Kirk in 2018 during their trip to Israel, in which Kirk raved about the hummus.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the host's and Kirk's 2018 Israel trip dates, itinerary and photos against her account of the restaurant lunch.
claims.transcript_snippet: It was actually a replay of an actual lunch that Charlie and I did have in the past back in 2018.

claims.label: Host Says the Real 2018 Trip Was for the Embassy Opening but the Dream Placed Them at Netanyahu's Wife's Funeral
claims.claim: The host says that in the dream the setting differed from the real trip, which was for the opening of the embassy: they were instead there for the funeral of the wife of Benjamin Netanyahu, whom she says she has never met or spoken about; she says she does not understand the difference.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the host and Kirk attended the 2018 US embassy opening in Jerusalem (travel records, photos) to anchor the real-trip half of the claim; the dream half is not testable.
claims.transcript_snippet: Instead, we were there in this dream setting for BB Netanyahu's wife's funeral.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie in the Dream Told Her He Had Little Time and She Must See What Happened on His Left
claims.claim: The host says that in the dream Charlie Kirk told her he did not have much time and that she needed to see what happened on his left.
claims.investigative_direction: Not independently testable; compare with the host's other accounts of the dream across episodes for consistency.
claims.transcript_snippet: Charlie said to me, I don't have much time. He followed that up explaining to me uh that I needed to see what happened on his left.

claims.label: Host Says Charlie in the Dream Said Multiple People Betrayed Him
claims.claim: The host says Charlie Kirk told her explicitly in the dream that multiple people betrayed him and that she replied she knew but could not learn who.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare this version of the dream with the host's earlier accounts for any change in who or how many are said to have betrayed him.
claims.transcript_snippet: And he told me explicitly, they betrayed me, multiple people.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet's Face Appeared in the Dream in the Third Week After Charlie's Death
claims.claim: The host says the face that finally came through in the dream, clear as day from around the corner of the restaurant, was Andrew Kolvet's, in the third week after Kirk's death.
claims.investigative_direction: Date the dream against the date of the text to Kolvet (A-1607.1) to confirm the sequence the host describes.
claims.transcript_snippet: It wasn't until the third week after his death that finally one face came through in this dream.

claims.label: Host Says She Was Friendly With Kolvet and Had Spoken With Him Extensively After the Assassination
claims.claim: The host says she had known Andrew Kolvet for years, was very friendly with him and had spoken with him extensively in the aftermath of Charlie's death before she texted him about the dream.
claims.investigative_direction: Phone and message logs between the host and Kolvet from September 2025 would show the frequency and end date of their contact.
claims.transcript_snippet: In fact, I was very friendly with Andrew Kolvet. We had spoken extensively in the aftermath of Charlie's death.

claims.label: Host Says It Was Kolvet Orchestrating the Attacks and He Was Caught Red-Handed
claims.claim: The host says that today they learn Andrew Kolvet has been orchestrating the attacks on her and that he was caught red-handed, and that she did not assume this earlier because she thought they were good guys who loved Charlie.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify what 'caught red-handed' refers to (likely earlier episodes on Kolvet's contacts with YouTubers) and obtain the underlying messages or records.
claims.transcript_snippet: we learn that it's been Andrew Kolvet orchestrating all of these attacks actually got caught red-handed.

claims.label: Host Says Two People in Kolvet's Inner Circle Told Her to Look More Into Him
claims.claim: The host says that after the dream, two people within Andrew Kolvet's inner circle reached out and told her she should look more into Kolvet.
claims.investigative_direction: Only the host's sources can confirm; ask whether either has gone on record or can be corroborated by documents.
claims.transcript_snippet: two people within Andrew's inner circle reached out to me and told me that I should look more into Andrew Kolvet.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Once Asked Her in Earnest Whether She Is a Witch
claims.claim: The host says that before AmFest, while she was in London, Andrew Kolvet phoned and asked her in earnest whether she is a witch, because bad things happen to people who attack her; she says she laughed and answered no.
claims.investigative_direction: Phone records for the call before AmFest and any witness to it; Kolvet could be asked to confirm or deny.
claims.transcript_snippet: asked me, "Are you a witch?" But I laughed at him on the phone.

claims.label: Host Says Kolvet Told Her Dennis Prager Fell and Was Seriously Injured After Writing About Her
claims.claim: The host says Kolvet told her that Dennis Prager, who had just written an open article about her, had fallen and been seriously injured, and that Kolvet cited this as an example of bad things happening to those who attack her.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the date and nature of Prager's injury and the date of his article about the host from public reporting.

claims.claim: The host says Kolvet went on to cite 'the Daily Wire thing and the Jordan Peterson thing' as further examples of bad things happening to people after they attack her.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Kolvet to confirm the conversation; check which Daily Wire and Peterson events he meant.
claims.transcript_snippet: Oh, the Daily Wire thing and the Jordan Peterson thing and like bad things are happening to people after they attack you.

claims.claim: The host says the Korean man Sun Myung Moon was actually working for the CIA while leading what became a religious cult.
claims.investigative_direction: Check declassified CIA and Korean intelligence records, and congressional findings on the Unification Church, for any documented relationship with Moon.
